changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO SHIFT_LINK_STAT (ADS_OWNER, USER_NAME, PLATFORM_NAME, ADS_NAME, LINK_COUNT, SAMPLE_URL, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE) SELECT ADS_OWNER, COALESCE(USER_NAME, ''), COALESCE(PLATFORM_NAME, ''), COALESCE(ADS_NAME, ''), COUNT(*), LEFT(MAX(FULL_URL), 1024), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM SHIFT_LINK GROUP BY ADS_OWNER, COALESCE(USER_NAME, ''), COALESCE(PLATFORM_NAME, ''), COALESCE(ADS_NAME, '') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LINK_COUNT = LINK_COUNT + VALUES(LINK_COUNT), UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
